Confirm the contracted revision, area basis, plot, inclusions and final specification. Published golf townhome interior concepts do not establish every villa or mansion finish or membership entitlement.

review.imagery: Root reviewed all 46 main brochure spreads, both nine-page Par brochures, all eighteen extracted main resources, both extracted Par resources and sixteen current website candidates. Twenty selected architectural/course renders preserve their published home-family or master-community scope. Five interior renders remain golf townhome concepts from the current official gallery. Generic lifestyle imagery, Lobb portfolio photographs from other courses, diagram thumbnails and site icons were excluded. The Par 3 native JPEG2000 resource has a lossless WebP delivery derivative, with its full original PDF preserved.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all twenty delivered complete sheets and every visible GSA panel. Eight independently checked level sums match 1150, 910, 547, 372, 237, 204, 229 and 318 m². All original level drawings, area/key-plan pages, full regional/master sheets, notices, source PDFs and physical-page links remain intact. Office/gym/bedroom flexible rooms retain their source status. Current Par size revisions remain explicitly different. The factsheet and payment document were visually reviewed for source context and excluded from the floor-plan selector. Existing commercial terms remain preserved.
review.location: Root read the complete current regional JPEG, original brochure regional/master sheets and factsheet map. The four published estimates agree across these reviewed sources. Disneyland proposed-resort context follows the original Disney/Miral announcement reviewed for this chapter. No home entrance, live route, kilometre journey or surveyed pin was inferred from the regional artwork or sales-centre coordinates.
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts preserve current official HTML and image URLs, five original broker-hosted PDFs, dates, original bytes and SHA256. Native media remains attributable to original brochure physical pages. Whole source drawings and three original residence PDFs retain their original bytes. All protected identities and existing commercial research remain preserved.

unavailable: Final contracted Par revision and area basis, individual plot areas, residence-specific interior finishes, golf membership/access entitlements, surveyed home entrances, current live routes and kilometre journeys remain unavailable or unverified.
